notes: 0.4.0 formaliza reintegro físico, incidencias Retail y conciliación offline como contratos externos de Inventario.
Las rutas administrativas derivadas de capacidades sin path explícito quedan marcadas como provisionales internas.
Las mutaciones de auditoría de precios no se exponen porque el log es append-only.

x-async-events.note: Reserva/consumo/liberación mantienen resultados asíncronos. Incidencias, reintegros y conciliación offline devuelven resultado HTTP autoritativo y pueden publicar inventory.stock.changed después del commit. Cupones e inicializaciones P1 se documentan en AsyncAPI 0.4.0.

x-customer-ref-contract.anonymous_rule: null is allowed only when the business rule does not require a per-customer limit.
x-customer-ref-contract.consumer_rule: Channels copy the authenticated customer sub; Sales persists the same value as contacto.clienteId.

x-error-contract.rule: Los consumidores deben ramificar por code y no por title/detail.

x-integration-decisions.catalog_inventory_initialization: Catalog initializes every sellable SKU via inventory.sku.initialization.requested.
x-integration-decisions.catalog_pricing_initialization: Catalog initializes the product-level base price via pricing.product.initialization.requested.
x-integration-decisions.channels_inventory_role: Marketplace y Chatbot solo consultan. Retail consulta y además puede reportar/resolver incidencias físicas; ninguna venta de canal reserva, consume, libera o reintegra stock directamente.
x-integration-decisions.chatbot_a5: Closed. Chatbot uses published Productos routes. Recommendation route is GET /recomendaciones, not /recomendaciones/candidatos.
x-integration-decisions.chatbot_a6: Closed. Chatbot sends destino + lineas(sku,cantidad) to Despacho; Despacho calls /productos/datos-fisicos/consulta with modulo-despacho credentials. Chatbot does not calculate kg/m3.
x-integration-decisions.chatbot_a7: Closed. GET /productos supports q for free-text search.
x-integration-decisions.coupon_consumption_transport: Contrato asíncrono lógico consolidado en asyncapi/asyncapi.yaml 0.4.0. No se introduce endpoint HTTP público adicional.
inventory_flow: F3 devolución física recibida y apta -> reintegro directo por Postventa (M2); otros motivos contractuales pueden usar Ventas (M1)
venta Retail offline sincronizada -> conciliación solicitada por Ventas/Postventa
x-integration-decisions.inventory_orchestrator: Ventas para reserva/consumo/liberación; Postventa invoca directamente el reintegro F3
x-integration-decisions.retail_physical_incidents: Retail reporta hechos físicos; inventory-svc decide y persiste el efecto sobre blocked/on_hand.
x-integration-decisions.warehouse_transfer_authorization: No new global Security role. userBearer is mapped locally by sub to capabilities INVENTARIO_TRASLADOS_LEER and INVENTARIO_TRASLADOS_RECIBIR.
x-integration-decisions.warehouse_transfer_reception: TRASLADO_ALMACEN_CENTRAL is received by a human inventory operator inside Productos y Ofertas. Retail initiates the transfer through incident resolution; Dispatch does not own stock re-entry.

catalogo:leer.note: modulo-productos usa catalogo:leer solo en obtenerProducto, obtenerContextoSku y GETs de lectura maestra señalados en sus allowlists; esto no habilita otras operaciones. G7 debe confirmar grant y provisión de credenciales; la identidad no individualiza microservicios.

inventario:disponibilidad:leer.note: modulo-productos se permite solo en consultarDisponibilidadComercial; no autoriza lectura detallada ni verificación cuantitativa. Grant G7 pendiente.

precios:leer.note: modulo-productos se permite solo en consultarPrecios y obtenerPrecioSku (GET) para lecturas de Catalog, Promotions y Combos; conserva precios:leer. La allowlist no acredita grant. G7 debe confirmar concesión y provisionar credenciales.

Este estado no certifica el estado actual del servidor, la correspondencia individual de bindings, conectividad, entrega, ACK, homologación, despliegue ni pruebas E2E.

x-rabbitmq-policy.business_rejection_rule: Business rejections are acknowledged and translated to contract results/events; they are not sent to retry/DLQ.
x-rabbitmq-policy.unroutable_publish_behavior: If the primary exchange cannot route a message but po.sin-ruta.x routes it to po.sin-ruta.q, RabbitMQ considers it routed and does not send basic.return; if the alternate exchange also cannot route it, mandatory=true causes basic.return. Publisher confirms are an independent signal.

observation.note: The observed count does not establish exact correspondence with AsyncAPI bindings; no binding definition export is available here.

outbox_inbox.consumer: Inbox/deduplication by message_id before side effects; business operation_id remains idempotency key.
outbox_inbox.publisher: Transactional Outbox before publish; mark published only after publisher confirm.

po.sin-ruta.q.purpose: Detectar publicaciones sin binding; no es una cola de negocio.

retry_flow: Consumer receives from main quorum queue with manual ack.
Transient technical failure: republish the same envelope to po.retry.x with routing key equal to the main queue name and x-retry-count + 1; ack original.
Retry queue waits 30000 ms and dead-letters directly back to the main queue through the default exchange.
After 3 application retries, publish to po.dlx.x with routing key equal to the main queue name; ack original.
Malformed/schema-unsupported poison messages go directly to DLQ.
Business rejections are acked and emit their domain rejected result when the contract defines one.
